properties.comment: Synthetic flood-demo fixture, hand-entered 2026-10-17. Polygon covers the lower Snoqualmie River floodplain (Fall City / Carnation); gage values are anchored on the USGS Snoqualmie gauge 12144500 (verified live response in skywatch-notes/samples/usgs_snoqualmie_12144500.json, whose real observed gage height was 2.56 ft on 2026-10-17). Values here are demo values: 9.42 ft vs flood stage 9.0 ft. Flood stage 9.0 ft is a documented assumption (see src/ingest/river.ts FLOOD_STAGES) - verify against NWS AHPS before any real use.

properties.area: Lower Snoqualmie valley near Fall City
